page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Printed page number at top left. Below the text, a reference "Matth.1." set in the column. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.l: Cùm esset desponsa mater ejus Maria
perta est uterum ferre ex spiritu sancto.
Iosephus vero vir ejus, qui justus esset, nec
in eam vellet exemplum edere, statuit e-
am clam repudiare. Haec cum haberet
in animo, ecce Domini angelus in somnis
apparuit ei, et ita locutus est: Iosephe Da-

l.i: vide prognate, ne metue asciscere Mari-
am uxorem tuam: nam quod in ea geni-
tum est, ex sancto spiritu est. Pariet au-
tem filium, quem Iesum nomine vocabis:
is enim suos ab ipsorum peccatis vindi-
cabit. Hoc autem totum factum est, ut
confieret, quod a Domino dictum fue-
rat per vatem ita dicentem: Virgo ven-
trem latura est, et editura filium, qui

main_text.l: est ac si dicas, Nobiscum Deus. Igitur
experrectus a somno Iosephus, fecit ut ei
suam conjugem: nec eam cognovit, do-
nec ea peperit filium suum primogeni-

page.notes: The Latin text is in italic type from "Iosephe" to "Deus." The printed section number is "XCVII." set centred and in capitals; it is transcribed as a paragraph because it is a bare number. The reference mark before "Matth.1." is a printed hand or fleuron and is not transcribed. The page number "218" is partly worn and read as 218 with doubt. The letter-forms of "confieret" and "asciscere" are read from worn type and may be doubtful.
